intent.proves: At least one active product is priced in points or one active discount converts points to money.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts WHERE ProductActive = 1 AND ProductPoints > 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDiscount WHERE DiscountActive = 1 AND DiscountLoyaltyPointsRate > 0)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
